payload.core_mechanism_summary: Scans array with a pointer i, tracks last seen heater p, and last selected q. When i reaches q+2r-1, selects p as new q (if p!=q) to covet next uncovered position, else fails.
payload.rationale: The code uses two pointers (i and q) to greedily pick the rightmost heater covering the leftmost uncovered spot, a classic greedy interval covering strategy without sorting or extra data structures.
